_comment: Upwork-independence GTM execution plan = the ONLY agent-writable surface during an optimize run. Every field is a DECISION; the reality that turns a decision into money is locked in tools/scorers/gtm-roi.py (30-month horizon). Edit values, not structure. Bounds + enums enforced by tools/gtm-plan-validate.py. Baseline is a deliberately naive plan (even 50/50 hedge, work-hard capacity, reference pricing); the loop climbs from here.
